ans: WooMeNow is a collaborative platform powered by our community and trusted local influencers. We help people discover the best restaurants and experiences for date nights and family outings—while offering businesses risk-free, influencer-driven content and growth-focused reviews.

que: How is WooMeNow different from traditional review sites?
ans:
We’re not here to tear businesses down—we lift them up.
  • Positive feedback gets featured and celebrated.
  • Negative feedback is first sent privately to the business.
  • If unresolved, it’s made public—but if the business responds, we can also spotlight how it was handled. It's all about accountability with empathy.

Our review system creates space for improvement, not punishment.
  • We highlight positive feedback!
  • For all negative feedback, we alert businesses privately first to respond and resolve the issue.
  • If ignored, we make the review public—but we’ll also highlight any resolution they provide afterward.

There’s no upfront cost for the video shoot. No obligation to pay until you're 100% happy.
If you love the reel we create for you, you can choose one of our content packages. If not, no worries—you owe nothing and  WooMeNow keeps the content rights.
Our creative team works alongside vetted local influencers to create engaging, story-driven video reels that feel authentic and connect with the audience you want to reach.

que: Can I use the video even if I don’t move forward?
ans: No. If you don’t approve the video or move forward with a paid campaign, WooMeNow retains all rights to the content. You’ll only gain usage rights once you invest in a content package.

que: What types of businesses does WooMeNow work with?
ans: Restaurants, entertainment venues, and experience-based businesses—especially those that care about community, relationships, and building something memorable.

que: What’s included in the Local Spotlight content package?
ans:
• Professionally filmed and edited video reels
  • A personalized date night shoot
  • Influencer collaboration
  • Featured placement in WooMeNow’s “Featured Partners” section.

que: How do I join WooMeNow as a business?
ans: Contact us directly or get recommended by a local influencer. We’ll qualify you for a free video shoot —with no payment due unless you love it.

que: How do I become an influencer with WooMeNow?
ans: We love partnering with trusted voices in the community. If you’re passionate about recommending your favorite local spots, DM us on Instagram or apply via our website!
